research_note: Announced 25 November 2026. Time Machine is a developer API capability, not literal time travel or a general consumer website rewind. Uses stored copies captured at or before snapshot_as_of; available history up to 365 days. Visuals from Perplexity must be credited and usage rights reviewed.

segments.title: AI CAN TIME TRAVEL?!
segments.caption: Perplexity launched Time Machine for developers.
segments.speech: Wait... AI can now time travel?! Well, not exactly! Perplexity has introduced something called Time Machine.

segments.title: SEARCH THE PAST WEB
segments.caption: See stored web snapshots from a chosen past date.
segments.speech: It lets AI agents search saved versions of web pages, as they existed at a chosen point in the past.

segments.title: CHOOSE A CUTOFF DATE
segments.caption: The API uses a snapshot_as_of timestamp.
segments.speech: Developers just set a timestamp called snapshot as of. The search then uses archived copies from before that cutoff.

segments.title: NO FUTURE SPOILERS
segments.caption: Test predictions without leaking later answers.
segments.speech: Imagine testing whether an AI could predict an event. Normally, today's web might reveal the answer. This gives it only information available back then!

segments.title: WOULD YOU TRY IT?
segments.caption: Historical snapshots, not a literal time machine.
segments.speech: Currently, it can go back up to three hundred sixty-five days. Would you try an AI time machine? I'm Zeno Sensei. Keep learning with Obscure!
